assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Tile fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And Category 101 has label "category-a" and Import Map 201 has Module Name "container-a"
4. And both references belong to "FMO_ADMIN" and the Tile page category filter value is Category 101
5. And the controlled creation clock returns 1700000000000 milliseconds
6. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Name" as "tile-012"
7. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Path" as "/fixture"
8. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Path" as "/case-012"
9. And the baseline fixture data defines "Role Entities" as "E-TRADE"
10. And the baseline fixture data defines "Filter Rule" as ""
11. And the baseline Tile references use "Aplication Category" "category-a" and "Container" "container-a"
12. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create New Tile" on the Tile administration page

15. And Admin A clicks the option labeled "container-a" in the expanded "Container" listbox for dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
16. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Name" with "tile-012" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
17. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Path" with "module a" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
18. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Tile Path" with "/case-012" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
19. And Admin A fills the textarea labeled "Role Entities" with "E-TRADE" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
